PostToolUse.description: Advisory-only formatting/console.log reminder after a Write/Edit — never blocks (always exits 0), per roadmap/10-plugin-and-installer.md's advisory-hook scope (distinct from the worker-context blocking hooks owned by 03/06).

Stop.description: The manager autonomy gate — the ONE deliberately BLOCKING manager hook (roadmap/10 scope amendment, 2026-07-27). Refuses to let a turn end while a Crabgic run is still in flight, so the operating protocol's autonomy clause is enforced rather than merely requested. Allows the stop at `awaiting_approval` (a human gate is legitimately open) and at every terminal state, honors `stop_hook_active` as its loop guard (docs/engine-baseline.md §19.2), and fails open on every error path.

The manager report-format gate — the SECOND deliberately blocking manager hook (2026-08-11). Refuses to end a turn on a wall of prose, so `docs/presentation-policy.md`'s reporting rules are enforced for the manager channel rather than merely stated. Keys on `last_assistant_message` (docs/engine-baseline.md §19.3); exempts code fences, tables, quotes and bullets; blocks at most once per turn via `stop_hook_active` (§19.2); fails open on every error path.
Advisory-only end-of-session reminder (e.g. pending approvals) — never blocks (always exits 0).
